_note: The Singing School (decision 0434), the lines spoken by people who exist already: Reverend Kent's ask, the tune books, Tolman down from the tower, the Tankard warning, and the evening. The townsfolk's own lines are in ss_town.json. All drafts for Matt or his writer friend.

lines.text: Mr. Burnbottom. They tell me you're leaving us.
Eventually. Everything I do is eventually.
Then one evening first. The singing school filled this house every winter. I have the house, and I have the winter. I haven't anyone to lead it, or anyone to sing.
Nobody's going to climb this hill to hear me sing hymns, Reverend. They've heard me sing everything else.
Then they'll need asking.
He looks at Eldwin when he says it.
Tonight, if it can be done. And Mr. Burnbottom. Sober.
I'm always sober in the mornings. It's my best time.
Miss Sprague will tell you we've nothing to sing from. She's right, as usual. Try the schoolhouse.
Four would do. Six would be a congregation. Anyone you can talk round.
Come up when you're ready. I'll light the candles, and the rest can come up as the day goes.
I've had letters from three towns asking how we did it. I'm going to tell them we asked.
Under the master's desk, a box gone soft with damp. Inside, six tune books, their covers foxed.
On every one, in what's left of the gilt: The Harlow Collection. H. Prentice.
Thadeous takes one and turns the pages without reading them.
He copied the first ones out by hand. Every part. He'd be appalled at the state of them.
The singing school. Submit asked me this morning. I told her I'd be up the tower.
The clock's going.
So it is. So it is.
She sings alto. I'd forgotten that. Tell her I'll come down.
Just to warm the pipes. One. Medicinal.
No.
No. No, you're right. Whipple would smell it on me from the square.
The meetinghouse is lit, a candle in every sconce, and there are people in the pews.
Old Hundredth. I'll give you the line, and you give it back. Don't be clever with it.
He sings the first line alone. They sing it back, ragged. Then, the second time, not.
Every candle in the house leans toward the front.
There.
They came. You asked them, and they came.
Every pew has somebody in it. Somebody is standing at the back.
